name: Kishi to Janken
source:
You end up in an other world public bath playing strip rock-scissors-paper with a kind knightess in this adventure game.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ286387.html]DLsite English[/url]]

一部異世界冒險遊戲：你會在公共浴場遇見一位女騎士，與她玩脫衣猜拳。
